metadata.title: Urban Build — Construction, Renovation & Restoration
metadata.description: Urban Build delivers construction, renovation, restoration and consulting services. Get in touch to discuss your project and request a clear, itemised quote.

hero.title: <accent>Building</accent> with care, from foundation to finish
hero.description: Urban Build handles construction, renovation, restoration and consulting. We start with a clear plan and a realistic quote, keep you updated throughout, and finish the work to a standard that lasts.
hero.imageAlt: Steel and concrete structure under construction

about.title: A construction team you can talk to
about.description: We're a construction business focused on getting the details right: honest quotes, clear timelines and tidy work. Whether it's a new build, a renovation, a repair or a second opinion on your plans, we treat your project like it matters — because it does.
about.imageAlt: Construction professional reviewing building plans on site

planning.title: Clear planning
planning.description: Every project starts with a written scope and schedule, so you know what happens and when.

communication.title: Open communication
communication.description: One point of contact and regular updates, so you're never guessing where the work stands.

workmanship.title: Solid workmanship
workmanship.description: Experienced trades and quality materials, finished to a standard we're proud to put our name to.

coordination.title: Coordinated delivery
coordination.description: We manage the schedule, trades and site so the work runs smoothly from start to handover.

services.title: What we do
services.description: Four core services covering new builds, improvements, repairs and expert advice. Each project is scoped and quoted before any work begins.

construction.title: Construction services
construction.description: We build with care from the ground up, making sure every structure is sound and built to last. From foundations to the final finishes, we turn approved plans into a finished building.

renovation.title: Renovation services
renovation.description: Updating and improving the spaces you already have. Whether it's a single room or a whole property, we plan the work around how you use the space and finish it cleanly.

restoration.title: Restoration services
restoration.description: Repairing structures that have been damaged or have simply aged. We assess the problem first, then carry out the repairs needed to make the building safe and sound again.

consulting.title: Consulting services
consulting.description: Practical advice before and during your project. We help you plan the work, understand the costs and avoid common mistakes — useful whether we build it or not.

work.title: The kind of work we take on
work.description: These are the main types of projects we handle. Each one is scoped, quoted and delivered to fit the site and the brief.

faq.title:
Got questions?

We have you covered
faq.description: From project planning to the final details, these are the answers to the questions we hear most often about working together.

cta.title: Still have a question?
cta.description: Talk to our team about your project and get a clear answer before you commit.

timeline.question: How long does a construction project usually take?
timeline.answer: Timelines vary with the size and complexity of the project. After a site visit we issue a schedule with clear milestones, and you receive progress updates at every stage.

permits.question: Do I need permits for my project?
permits.answer: Most construction projects require permits. We identify which approvals apply to your site and can guide you through the submissions.

materials.question: What materials do you use?
materials.answer: We use quality, durable materials selected to suit the project, the design and local safety requirements. The specification is agreed with you before work starts.

changes.question: Can I make changes after construction starts?
changes.answer: Yes. Changes are possible, but they may affect the timeline and the cost. We document every variation and confirm it with you before the work continues.

cost.question: How much will my construction project cost?
cost.answer: Cost depends on the size, materials, design and scope of the work. We provide a clear, itemised estimate based on your specific requirements.

safety.question: How do you ensure quality and safety on-site?
safety.answer: We follow recognised quality and safety practices, with regular site checks and documented progress throughout the project.

contact.title: Let's talk about your project
